{{Top|leg}}
'''Asteroid target shooting''' was a recreational activity that could be enjoyed by passengers aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Passengers used deck-mounted miniature [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to shoot the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
